image_description: A tall, antique wooden bookcase (likely a barrister or sectional style) filled with books. The unit features multiple glass-fronted upper sections with sliding or hinged doors and a solid wooden base cabinet with doors. It is situated in a room with warm lighting, next to a wooden counter and other furniture.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the bookcase and floor

These are minor semantic deviations rather than structural failures.
artifact_reasoning: The image is largely coherent but shows subtle AI artifacts. Book spine details are slightly blurred/gibberish (low severity), and background architectural lines show minor warping/perspective issues. The overall structure holds up well, but fine-grained geometric precision is lacking.
